svg.title: Check scaling first when Windows text and app screens look blurry
svg.desc: An English guide to the main sections of this article.

g.text: SEONGWOO CHOI / IT JOURNAL
Check scaling first when Windows text and app screens
look blurry
ARTICLE GUIDE · 2026-11-01
Match scaling across monitors
In Settings > System > Display, check the value
for “Change the size of text, apps, and other
items.” Microsoft’s support documentation…
Sign out and sign in again after
changing settings
The same document says that if apps look blurry
after connecting or disconnecting a monitor,
changing the docking state, or changing the…
Check only the blurry app separately
If only a specific app looks blurry, open
Properties > Compatibility > “Change high DPI
settings” from the app’s shortcut or executable…
Treat the driver as a last step
It is reasonable to suspect a graphics driver
problem only after checking scaling and signing
in again has not solved the issue.
AI-assisted article guide. Read the article and linked sources for details.
